errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the interval of 100 applies to the last group. The interval of 100 applies to the '100 - < 200' group, which is the second to last one. The last group is '≥ 200' and is open-ended.
The description claims there are eight bars, but the chart only shows seven bars for the seven categories on the x-axis.
The description refers to the values as approximate, but the exact numerical value is labeled above each bar in the chart (e.g., 0, 10, 220, 580).
